text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the Kisaragi Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All the Umamusume running look so 
strong... It is a GⅢ, after all...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no! I can't just keep thinking 
about what makes me nervous!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, for now, I'll just clear my 
head... and run with everything I've got!!
